name: Nu Gundam
author: mzhyui
source_notes: Independently AI-generated Codex pet adaptation by the submitter. Official Tamashii Nations Nu Gundam product images were used only as appearance references (https://tamashiiweb.com/item/12986/?wovn=en and https://tamashiiweb.com/item/13156/?wovn=en). The production records show generation and deterministic atlas assembly, not direct cropping or tracing of reference-image pixels. Reference images are not included in the submission.
license: Non-commercial use only. Unofficial fan-made adaptation; no affiliation with or authorization from the Gundam rights holders is claimed.
description: A compact RX-93 Nu Gundam companion with model-kit-inspired armor, an asymmetric stack of six attached fin funnels, nine task animations, and 16 look directions.
